title: alcea flavovirens
intro: Alcea flavovirens, commonly known as Golden Trumpet, is a plant species in the mallow family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alcea flavovirens include its analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-bacterial effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief, fever reduction, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
